meta.title: AI Workbench
meta.description: Describe a window in plain words; the model asks a few questions, builds it, and it mounts live inside DSH — then you can keep talking to it.

ai-workbench.title: AI Workbench
ai-workbench.panelHint: Describe a window in plain language and the model builds it
ai-workbench.noProjects: No project yet — describe a window below and one is created for you.
ai-workbench.requestPlaceholder: Say it in your own words, e.g. a water-drinking check-in sheet
ai-workbench.actionsHint: Only actions declared in _workbench.json are sent to the model; every other interaction stays local.
ai-workbench.layoutHint: Tell the model how to structure the page
ai-workbench.placementEmbeddedHint: Floats over this panel; best for a workbench you glance at while you keep chatting
ai-workbench.placementStandaloneHint: Gets its own browser tab; best for a workbench you use full-screen for a while
ai-workbench.waitingForModel: Waiting for the model to write the page…
ai-workbench.windowEmpty: This window has no page yet.
ai-workbench.windowBlocked: This page could not load. The file may be missing from the project folder.
ai-workbench.sessionNone: No session yet — one is created with the first request.
ai-workbench.sessionCreated: Started a session for this project.
ai-workbench.sessionFailed: Could not reach a session. Open a chat and ask the model to open the workbench.
ai-workbench.sent: Sent to the model. It will write the page into the project folder.
ai-workbench.commandPlaceholder: Type a command and press Enter (try: help)
ai-workbench.help: Commands: help · projects · windows · log · refresh · clear
